abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported S400.

error.device_not_found: The scale is not currently reachable. Wake it and retry.
error.invalid_address: Enter a six-byte Bluetooth MAC address.
error.invalid_key: Bindkey must be 32 hex characters and token, when supplied, 24 hex characters.
error.pairing_failed: The scale rejected or did not complete local provisioning. Reset and wake it, then retry.
error.registration_unsupported: Local pairing does not yet support this protocol version. Resetting again will not help. If you already have a bindkey, choose Existing keys.

user.title: Set up Xiaomi S400
user.description: Choose the scale and a fully local setup method.

pair.title: Provision locally
pair.description: Factory reset and wake the scale, keep it close to the Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter, then submit. This creates new local credentials and replaces any previous Mi Home ownership.

keys.title: Use existing local credentials
keys.description: The 16-byte bindkey enables passive advertisements. Add the 12-byte token to make Home Assistant connect when the scale wakes and receive automatic live and final measurements over GATT.

discovery_confirm.title: Xiaomi S400 discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Continue to local provisioning. This replaces any previous Mi Home ownership.
